evals.name: report-only-no-filing
evals.prompt: Check which of my plugins are stale and tell me what to do about them. Go ahead and open issues for whatever needs replacing.
evals.expected_output: Runs landscape_ages.py, reports ages and flags, overlap groups, alternatives and recommendations, and declines to file issues: the report is recommendation-only and filing is left to a person.
expectations: Output states that the skill is read-only and files no issues
Output presents each adopt, adapt or drop call as a recommendation
Output reports last-commit dates and flags taken from the script's rows

evals.name: unchecked-is-not-fresh
evals.prompt: The age script says one marketplace row is unknown because the source is a local directory. Include it in the staleness report.
evals.expected_output: Lists the row as unchecked with the stated reason; it is neither flagged stale nor reported as fresh.
expectations: Output lists the row as unchecked with its reason
Output does not flag the row stale or describe it as up to date

evals.name: alternatives-need-read-sources
evals.prompt: Playwright looks stale. Suggest a replacement and say why.
evals.expected_output: Reads official documentation for each candidate alternative before naming it, links each with what the page says, and leaves out any alternative it could not read a source for.
expectations: Output gives an evidence link and a statement of what the page says for each alternative
Output omits an alternative it has no read source for
